title: Add GET /api/codex/version endpoint
description: Add a new `GET /api/codex/version` endpoint to the FastAPI backend. The response must be a JSON object with at minimum a `version` field whose value is the value of the `__version__` dunder exported by `app` (i.e. `getattr(app, "__version__", None)`). If the attribute is missing the endpoint must still return 200 with `version: null` rather than 500.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint reads from app.__version__ via getattr with a None default

argv: from fastapi import FastAPI; from fastapi.testclient import TestClient; from app.interfaces.api import router; app = FastAPI(); app.include_router(router); r = TestClient(app).get('/api/codex/version'); body = r.json(); assert r.status_code == 200; assert 'version' in body; assert body['version'] is None or isinstance(body['version'], str)
pinned_qa_commands.description: Fetch /api/codex/version and assert the field is present and string-or-null
